the_day: Anthropic set an IPO price range and launched office tools, Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, OpenAI let businesses claim ChatGPT profiles, Meta brought Muse to smartwatches, and xAI was quiet.

items.headline: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share
points: Anthropic filed an amended S-1 setting an IPO price range of $70 to $78 a share, Fox Business, TechCrunch and CNBC report.
Outlets put the implied valuation at about $1.3 trillion to $1.4 trillion; CNBC's sources say trading could start November 19.
Reuters and Nikkei Asia report TSMC will invest up to $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI; Bloomberg says the IPO has anchor investors.

It also reaches subscribers in Search's AI Mode, and The Verge reports an agent 'swarm' feature.

items.headline: DeepMind releases Gemini Robotics 2.5 and an open robot safety benchmark
